title: Scope note edits to a verified Chance file
goal: Harden update_jobnimbus_note so a raw activity id cannot bypass the normal Chance-file match and edit an unrelated company note. Require a file query, resolve the Chance-owned file, and verify the target activity belongs to that file before planning or executing PUT /activities/{id}.
doneCriteria: The action requires both a Chance-file query and noteId.
The target activity is verified as related to the resolved file before execution.
Dry-run remains the default and ALLOW_JOBNIMBUS_WRITES plus execute:true remain mandatory.
A wrong-file or unrelated note id fails without issuing a PUT.
Fixture-safe checks cover the allowed and rejected paths.
constraints: Do not weaken write gates or Chance-only scope.
Do not test with a live write.
Do not include client PII, note bodies, credentials, or runtime exports in Git.
Use the artifact mailbox only if normal Git push fails.

log.note: created during review of e28024c; update_jobnimbus_note skips requireFileMatch and plans a PUT from noteId alone
